interface.signature: dict: List[str], N: int, K: int -> str

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(word, str) for word in dict)

preconditions.description: The integer `N` matches the length of the input list `dict`.
The number of words `N` is between 1 and 300.
The number of starting alphabets `K` is between 1 and 26.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(word) <= 50 for word in dict)
preconditions.description: Each word in `dict` has length between 1 and 50.

preconditions.expression: all(word[0] in dict[0] for word in dict)
preconditions.description: All words start with one of the `K` starting alphabets (implied by the problem's context).
The input `dict` is already sorted lexicographically according to the alien language.

postconditions.description: The returned string has exactly `K` characters.

postconditions.expression: all(c in return_value for c in set().union(*dict))
postconditions.description: All characters in the input words are present in the returned string.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value.index(c1) < return_value.index(c2) for i in range(N - 1) for c1, c2 in zip(dict[i], dict[i + 1]) if c1 != c2 and c1 == c2)
postconditions.description: For every pair of adjacent words in `dict`, the first differing character in the earlier word precedes the first differing character in the later word in the returned string.

postconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in return_value)
postconditions.description: All characters in the returned string are lowercase English letters.
